summary: Implemented sort-aware header cell rendering in BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer.
BaseGridRenderer::createHeaderCell() now branches on column.isSortable(): non-sortable columns render as plain text (unchanged); sortable columns delegate to new createSortLink() helper.
createSortLink() builds an containing the label, plus a ▲/▼ when the column is the active sort column.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createHeaderCell() overrides the base: delegates non-sortable columns to parent, and for sortable columns builds the same <th> structure but adds Bootstrap utility classes (text-decoration-none text-reset d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-1) to the <a> element.
All HTML uses HTMLTag::create() throughout — no raw string concatenation.
PHPStan level 6: 0 errors (44/44 files checked).
PHPUnit: 47/47 tests pass, 0 regressions.

comments.note: BaseGridRenderer::createSortLink() is a protected method that Bootstrap5Renderer cannot call directly to share the indicator-building logic. The Bootstrap5 override duplicates the indicator span creation. Extracting a protected createSortIndicatorSpan(string $dir): HTMLTag helper would allow both renderers to reuse it without fully overriding createSortLink(). Deferred — out of WP scope.

Bootstrap5Renderer previously imported only the types it directly referenced. The three new use statements (GridColumnInterface, DataGridInterface, AlignInterface) are now required for the override — all consistent with project conventions.

summary: WP-003 code review PASS. Both BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer implement sort-aware header cells correctly and cleanly.

All 8 acceptance criteria are satisfied. HTMLTag::create() is used throughout — zero raw string concatenation. Template Method pattern applied correctly: Bootstrap5Renderer overrides createHeaderCell() and delegates non-sortable columns to parent::createHeaderCell().
No blocking issues found. Implementation is correct, readable, and consistent with project conventions (declare(strict_types=1), fluent API, HTMLTag-only HTML output).

comments.note: Both BaseGridRenderer::createSortLink() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createHeaderCell() call $this->grid->sorting() 2–3 times each (getSortURL, isSortedBy, getSortDir). Extracting '$sorting = $this->grid->sorting()' as a local variable at the top of each method would improve readability and eliminate repeated method-chain dereferences. Purely cosmetic — sorting() likely returns a stored property — but consistent with idiomatic PHP style.

Bootstrap5Renderer::createHeaderCell() fully duplicates the <th> construction block from BaseGridRenderer (id, classes, text-align, nowrap, compact). This is a structural consequence of overriding the entire method rather than just the <a> element styling. The Developer's proposed protected createSortIndicatorSpan() helper is a step in the right direction; a further protected createSortAnchor(GridColumnInterface $column, array $extraClasses = []): HTMLTag factory in BaseGridRenderer could let Bootstrap5 customize only the link classes without duplicating the <th> wrapper. Deferred — not a defect, and a well-scoped refactor task for a future cycle.

No automated tests cover sort-aware header cell rendering (sortable vs non-sortable columns, active indicator, Bootstrap utility classes). The entire 47-test suite is scoped to pagination/actions/rows/cells. QA confirmed correctness via manual inspection and PHPStan for this WP, but a future regression in createHeaderCell() or createSortLink() would go undetected. A dedicated tests/Sorting/RendererSortHeaderTest.php is strongly recommended as a follow-up task.
